title: Noetherian smooth Rees geometry for a closed section
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings), let $d\geq0$, and let $g:V\to S$ be smooth, separated and of finite type of pure relative dimension $d$, with a closed section $s:S\hookrightarrow V$, $g s=1_S$.
For the ideal $\mathcal I$ of $s(S)$ set $\mathcal E=\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$, $\pi:N_s=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)\to S$, with zero section $z$. Set $D_sV=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_V\mathcal O_V[t,\mathcal I/t]$, using the subalgebra of $\mathcal O_V[t,t^{-1}]$ generated by $t$ and the $b/t$, $b\in\mathcal I$. Its structural map is $q:D_sV\to\mathbf A^1_S$ and its section $\sigma$ is the augmentation $t\mapsto t$, $\mathcal I/t\mapsto0$, with coefficients restricted by $s$.
The conormal is locally free of rank $d$. The scheme $D_sV$ is Noetherian, $q$ is smooth separated of finite type and pure relative dimension $d$, and $\sigma$ is closed. Both $q$ and $\pi$ are compactifiable. There are canonical identifications of pairs
$$(q,\sigma)|_{t=1}\cong(g,s),\qquad(q,\sigma)|_{t=0}\cong(\pi,z),\qquad(D_sV,\sigma)|_{t\ne0}\cong(V,s)\times_S\mathbf G_{m,S}.$$
The zero-fibre identification is induced by $[b]_m\mapsto[b t^{-m}]$ from the associated graded algebra to $\mathcal O_V[t,\mathcal I/t]/(t)$ and the canonical symmetric-to-graded map. For every centred affine etale chart $P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_d]\to B$ with $I=(x_1,\ldots,x_d)B$, the corresponding open in $D_sV$ has algebra
$$B[t,I/t]\cong B\otimes_P R[t,u_1,\ldots,u_d],\qquad x_j\mapsto t u_j.$$
These opens, together with the punctured deformation, cover $D_sV$. The bundle and deformation, all open restrictions to Noetherian chart sources, and all separated finite-type chart maps and structural composites are between Noetherian schemes and are compactifiable. Here compactifiable means admitting an open immersion into a scheme proper over the target.
The scheme, morphism, algebra and coefficient notation and the specified comparison maps are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra], [def-asd-compactifiable], [def-weil-etale-morphism].
